_metadata.description: VS Code tasks for backup and maintenance: file backup, configuration export, and workspace cleanup.

tasks.label: backup:workspace-full
args: -c

mkdir -p '${input:backupLocation}' && tar --exclude-from=<(echo '${input:excludePatterns}' | tr ',' '\n') -czf '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_full_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz' -C .. '$(basename "$PWD")' && echo 'Full backup completed'
-Command

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '${input:backupLocation}' -Force; $excludePatterns = '${input:excludePatterns}' -split ','; $backupPath = '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_full_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '.zip'; Compress-Archive -Path . -DestinationPath $backupPath -Force; Write-Host 'Full backup completed'

tasks.label: backup:workspace-incremental
args: -c

mkdir -p '${input:backupLocation}' && find . -newer '${input:backupLocation}/.last_backup' 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '(node_modules|__pycache__|.git|dist|build)' | tar -czf '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_incremental_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz' -T - && touch '${input:backupLocation}/.last_backup' && echo 'Incremental backup completed'
-Command

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '${input:backupLocation}' -Force; $lastBackup = '${input:backupLocation}/.last_backup'; $changedFiles = Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date '1/1/1970') }; $backupPath = '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_incremental_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '.zip'; Compress-Archive -Path $changedFiles -DestinationPath $backupPath -Force; Set-Content -Path $lastBackup -Value (Get-Date); Write-Host 'Incremental backup completed'

tasks.label: backup:source-only
args: -c

mkdir -p '${input:backupLocation}' && tar -czf '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_source_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz' --include='*.py' --include='*.js' --include='*.ts' --include='*.jsx' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.html' --include='*.css' --include='*.json' --include='*.md' --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' --exclude-from=<(echo '${input:excludePatterns}' | tr ',' '\n') . && echo 'Source backup completed'
-Command

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '${input:backupLocation}' -Force; $sourceFiles = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Include '*.py','*.js','*.ts','*.jsx','*.tsx','*.html','*.css','*.json','*.md','*.yml','*.yaml' | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '(node_modules|__pycache__|.git|dist|build)' }; $backupPath = '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_source_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '.zip'; Compress-Archive -Path $sourceFiles -DestinationPath $backupPath -Force; Write-Host 'Source backup completed'

tasks.label: backup:vscode-settings
tasks.detail: Backup VS Code settings and tasks
args: -c

mkdir -p '${input:backupLocation}' && if [ -d '.vscode' ]; then tar -czf '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_vscode_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz' .vscode && echo 'VS Code settings backup completed'; else echo 'No .vscode directory found'; fi
-Command

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '${input:backupLocation}' -Force; if (Test-Path '.vscode') { $backupPath = '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_vscode_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '.zip'; Compress-Archive -Path '.vscode' -DestinationPath $backupPath -Force; Write-Host 'VS Code settings backup completed' } else { Write-Host 'No .vscode directory found' }

tasks.label: backup:git-repository
args: -c
mkdir -p '${input:backupLocation}' && git bundle create '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_git_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).bundle' --all && echo 'Git repository backup completed'
-Command

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '${input:backupLocation}' -Force; $backupPath = '${input:backupLocation}/${input:backupName}_git_' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '.bundle'; git bundle create $backupPath --all; Write-Host 'Git repository backup completed'

tasks.label: backup:list-backups
args: -c
if [ -d '${input:backupLocation}' ]; then ls -lah '${input:backupLocation}' | grep '${input:backupName}'; else echo 'No backup directory found'; fi
-Command

if (Test-Path '${input:backupLocation}') { Get-ChildItem -Path '${input:backupLocation}' | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*${input:backupName}*' } | Format-Table Name, Length, LastWriteTime } else { Write-Host 'No backup directory found' }

tasks.label: backup:cleanup-old
args: -c

if [ -d '${input:backupLocation}' ]; then find '${input:backupLocation}' -name '*${input:backupName}*' -type f -mtime +30 -delete && echo 'Old backups cleaned up'; else echo 'No backup directory found'; fi
-Command

if (Test-Path '${input:backupLocation}') { Get-ChildItem -Path '${input:backupLocation}' | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*${input:backupName}*' -and $_.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-30) } | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host 'Old backups cleaned up' } else { Write-Host 'No backup directory found' }

tasks.label: backup:restore-workspace
args: -c
echo 'Available backups:' && ls -1 '${input:backupLocation}'/*${input:backupName}*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo 'To restore, manually extract the desired backup file'
-Command

Write-Host 'Available backups:'; Get-ChildItem -Path '${input:backupLocation}' | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*${input:backupName}*.zip' } | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table Name; Write-Host 'To restore, manually extract the desired backup file'

tasks.label: backup:verify-integrity
args: -c
for backup in '${input:backupLocation}'/*${input:backupName}*.tar.gz; do echo "Checking $backup"; tar -tzf "$backup" >/dev/null && echo "✓ OK" || echo "✗ CORRUPTED"; done
-Command

Get-ChildItem -Path '${input:backupLocation}' | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*${input:backupName}*.zip' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Checking $($_.Name)"; try { Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($_.FullName).Dispose(); Write-Host '✓ OK' } catch { Write-Host '✗ CORRUPTED' } }

tasks.label: backup:schedule-daily
args: -c

echo 'To setup daily backups, add this to your crontab:' && echo '0 2 * * * cd "$(pwd)" && code --wait .vscode/tasks.json && /usr/bin/timeout 300 code --folder-uri "$(pwd)" --command workbench.action.tasks.runTask backup:workspace-incremental' && echo 'Run: crontab -e'
-Command

Write-Host 'To setup daily backups on Windows, use Task Scheduler:'; Write-Host '1. Open Task Scheduler'; Write-Host '2. Create Basic Task'; Write-Host '3. Set trigger to Daily at 2:00 AM'; Write-Host '4. Set action to run: code --command workbench.action.tasks.runTask backup:workspace-incremental'

tasks.label: backup:complete-workflow
tasks.detail: Complete backup workflow: full, settings, git, cleanup
